snippets.author: Brad Godfrey
snippets.text: Excellent show. Friendly staff. Went to the Garth Brooks tribute band.

snippets.author: Michelle Bennett
snippets.text:
This place is great!! I highly recommend it. There are tons of lifeguards, and they are all focused on watching the water. You are also allowed to bring your own food and drink it.
I wish our town had this.
This aquatic center is extremely well run. The director is doing a great job.

snippets.author: eric
snippets.text: I came in 3 times looking to get a shower, but the pool was closed during the time I came in. But I don't want to go in the pool, I just wanna shower. And they still turn me away. The pool is only open a couple hours a day to the public. Every time I come in here there is no one in this giant building and they still refuse to let me take a shower. I really hate this place.

snippets.author: Debbie Shreenan
snippets.text: My daughter and I took my grandson to a pumpkin painting class. There was about 20 people there, just enough to not be so overwhelming. We had a blast. The staff is amazing!

snippets.author: Rita Lynn Garrity
snippets.text:
Enjoy playing pickleball here. 4 courts set up. $3 a person for 3 hour session. Can be confusing with the various lines. Wish the AC worked better.
Great group of people. Good times.

name: Our Lady of the Lake Catholic School

snippets.author: the flowing Drowner
snippets.text: According to many accounts, this place has a dark vibe to it. No wonder. Look up : Nathan Reynolds and the Podcast on YouTube called "The confessionals". This place should be prayed for - and over. I encourage every Christian, no matter their denomination, to pray for this church. Especially their leaders. Spiritual Warfare isn't an option anymore. It's a duty. ❤️🙏🏻✝️

snippets.author: Janell Eidson
snippets.text: I practically grew up around Our Lady of the Lake. From the the old church to the new, (they had a rebuild because of the growth in attendance some years ago). Attended every Sunday, CCD classes, Vacation Bible School that they hosted every year. Among other events that they hold on a regular basis for families and their parishioners. It was and is still a beautiful church. I have since moved away from Arizona, but have so many fond memories. My grandmother MaryAnn who has now passed adored this church as well, and attended since the late 70s-2024. I will always hold Our Lady of The Lake in high regard. Beautiful church and place of worship with beautiful people. :)

snippets.author: Kerrie Anne Loyd
snippets.text: We had a wonderful experience with the pre-school and elementary school here. Good curriculum, excellent teachers, caring and helpful staff, and welcoming and respectful students. NO bullies. Even though it is still a small school, Our Lady has many activities and clubs for students to participate in. The school is represented at community events and they have dances, fairs, plays, religious, sports and patriotic clubs. Students take music and PE. Parents are very involved and contribute a lot to the success of the school. I think it will continue to grow bigger and better and hope to find a similar school for my daughter in our new hometown.

snippets.author: mary part
snippets.text: Visited lake Havasu & attendant Sunday morning Mass ,beautiful Catholic Church & Very welcoming

snippets.author: Haplo Blank
snippets.text: Y'all got called out ☠️ Let the light of Jesus destroy all evil 🔥

snippets.author: Jo Young
snippets.text:
Despite its reputation for snootiness, I thought Telesis was great, for a little while. However, this school, cares more about reputation, than students. The teachers play favorites, and if you're not one of them, you get table scraps of attention. Not to mention the fact that they will protect teachers, who are regularly complained about by parents. I have been so let down by this school, and so have my children. Guess they didn't get on the favorite list. And I'd be willing to bet that nearly every positive review on here, is from the parents of those that are on the list. And the rest are staff. Don't get me wrong, I'm happy for any child who feels they are getting the attention they need at school. But as teachers, and school staff, they're supposed to be as impartial as possible. Apparently not at Telesis... if I could give a half star, I would.
I also find it sooooo funny that Telesis is more than willing to respond to their positive comments. Cause they don't care about kids. Not unless they are from an important family, or a prodigy. It's all about the favorite kids.

snippets.author: Jane B
snippets.text: As a parent, I am extremely grateful for the teachers and administrators at this school.  The teachers have always kept me informed and there is great communication from the principal, counselor, and the other office staff. I love the school culture, and it's clear that everyone on staff is focused on providing a great learning experience for students. They are always greeted in the morning by staff, and the principal and counselor never fail to be there to talk to students if needed. It's hard raising kids these days, and no school is perfect, but it's proven to me that Telesis cares.

snippets.author: Amy Mullings
snippets.text:
I am writing to share my positive experience with Telesis Preparatory, where I have had the pleasure of knowing some exceptional educators. The teachers at Telesis are among the best in the state, demonstrating a deep commitment to their students' success. Their dedication and willingness to go above and beyond truly set them apart.

The leadership at Telesis further enhances the learning environment, fostering a community where students can thrive academically and personally. If you are seeking a school with caring and dedicated educators, I wholeheartedly recommend Telesis Preparatory.

snippets.author: Nick Dames
snippets.text: I thank for for Telesis. Everyone who works there hands down cares for the kiddos. My daughter is actually very excited to get up and go to school.

snippets.author: Bryan Koryta
snippets.text: I had been suspended for my sixth grade year and it’s a hands off campus and I had not laid a finger on him when I got into a fight… ALSO my brother had been having problems with a kid in class bullying him and he got suspended multiple times and finally defended himself and now got suspended for two days because this kid punched him first I really do not like how they do not have cameras in the areas of a fight… if they are having problems with those areas then PUT CAMERAS THERE!!!

snippets.author: Pete Tapia
snippets.text: Courts are in great condition and open to the public.  The lights work well and stayed on past 10p when we were there in December.

snippets.author: Kim Vigil
snippets.text: Clean and nicely kept courts!

snippets.author: Larry Ray
snippets.text: too much graffiti,  zero tennis players

snippets.author: Claire Roy
snippets.text: I wold give this place a negative rating if i could. The director not understanding and was very rude to me when issues arrived. She is very quick to unenroll and basically gave up on my son. I don't feel safe with my kids here. Considering an investigation on her business. Do yourself a favor and find a different daycare.

snippets.author: Jay
snippets.text: My daughter has gone here for 3 months. Before she started there she was barely potty trained and with in a month she was going a full day with no accidents. the teachers are amazing and Karen is so flexible with my daughter’s part time schedule. I will always recommend this daycare.

snippets.author: Tiffany Harmon
snippets.text: If you're needing help with your child being fully potty trained don't call here. A lot of the reviews said they help with potty training and it's not true. Good luck finding a different place to send your child. Because they are not helpful in that department of teaching.

snippets.author: Bethany Sky
snippets.text: My son absolutely loves this place and his teachers. We love how much they have helped him grow emotionally and prepare for kindergarten while still having fun.

snippets.author: Peter Mechur
snippets.text: I would highly recommend finding a different daycare.

snippets.author: Bre Valdez
snippets.text:
I’m not one to leave reviews really, but I couldn’t let that 1star review go. Considering our children graduated classes/ teachers for 2 maybe even 3years together. It seems very odd that a parent would keep their child in a daycare they thought so poor of for that long. Let’s not lie and pretend it had anything else to with other than your child biting all the kids in that facility, mine included!!
That post couldn’t be more untrue. This place is amazing and so are the teachers.

snippets.author: Nathan Kennedy
snippets.text: Started out as a good daycare. Then was nothing but problems no real structure hardly worked with child on potty training quick to just call parents to pick up child instead of working with them to figure out the issue. Non speaking English teachers. ( not saying they are bad because 1& 2 great sweet teacher.) watched my child’s class room go thru multiple teacher. Also would pick up child multiple times wet back to back. They just say ok. Not a lot of child development!

snippets.author: Britt Henderson
snippets.text: This is the first place I’ve had the courage to leave my L.O, being a StayAtHomeMom for 4 years prior to my youngest, I felt that it was time to work again even though my L.O was only 2. I was new to Havasu and didn’t know anybody and honestly I didn’t trust anyone, until I found this place. They were incredibly welcoming and loving not only to my child but to me as well. They had that down to earth, felt like family vibe.( hints the name lol). Not only did my child love her first day but wanted to go back, and that was important to me. We have been apart of Family tree for about 2 years now and I can not believe how much my child has learned. 10 out of 10.

snippets.author: Brittani Kelley
snippets.text: Amazing staff with so much heart and caring mindset, not to mention the beautiful hand painted walls. I have two great nieces who get excited about coming every day. Thank you ladies for being so great to my little babes!

snippets.author: Susan Humphrey
snippets.text: Such a good experience.  Excellent daycare. Great teachers. I think we were very lucky to have found you guys!

snippets.author: Steve Hawkins
snippets.text: The school is very well run by caring and excellent  professional teachers. It's a fun place for the kids too. My son loves it and has really grown. I would definitely recommend  this school. It's terrific.

snippets.author: Alexis Grabner
snippets.text: Too many kids not enough teachers

snippets.author: Sarah Matheis
snippets.text: This school has been amazing with my little Emma! She has been there for almost 2 years now. She just loves everyone there! They have always made her feel so welcome.

snippets.author: COURTNEY RUTLEDGE
snippets.text: They are amazing my kids have been there for 2 years now and absolutely love it Mrs Kim Mia the absolute GREATEST

snippets.author: Fiona Robertson
snippets.text: They really care about kids here. Could not ask for a better place for my daughter

snippets.author: Elona Shea
snippets.text: My son loves it there.

snippets.author: Sofia Moroyoqui
snippets.text: This school is closed

snippets.author: Courtney Tamayo
snippets.text: We absolutely LOVE Nelly! We have been going there for 7 months now and when we leave our baby with her, there is zero worry. Her daycare is always so clean and she has all the coolest toys, my son never wants to leave! It is evident how much she cares about the kids and it does not go unnoticed by me.

snippets.author: Viviana Martinez Duran
snippets.text: If you want to protect your child, I would never take them here. Its ridiculous how bad they are treating those poor babies.

snippets.author: catherine vanantwerp
snippets.text: This women should not be watching children! She belittles parents and kicks them out when parents talk about their any concerns!

snippets.author: Ryan Murphy
snippets.text: Yeah, don't bring your kids here.

snippets.author: christina Kramer
snippets.text: Absolutely love this school! Both my kids have attended and the teachers are the best!! Special shout out to Ms Shelly who my son absolutely loved while there! Ms Shanna & Janessa whom my daughter just loves and can’t wait to see everyday she is there.

snippets.author: Bob Owings
snippets.text: I wouldn’t recommend this facility for anyone wishing to teach their children right from wrong. They employ a staff member whose family has no regards for others in the community and racial bias overtones. I recommend you chose a facility that does more extensive employment screening. Don’t subject your children to this type of influence.
